summary: Designed, implemented, and evaluated the distributional afterstate ranker pilot line: successor-closed action-complete corpus generator (aligned chance scenarios, common random numbers, whole-origin folds, cross-fold dedup), exact fair-D4 comparator labeler reusing the pinned reference byte-identically, seed-free CHECK self-test, and a ROCm PyTorch trainer (quantile + within-root ranking losses, GPU-resident batches). Ran three preregistered iterations (K=8 inconclusive, K=64 inconclusive, K=256 valid negative): the calibrated model beats its D1 teacher but trails fair D4 at held-out sibling ranking, so the direct-play configuration is not supported as tested. Wrote theory, experiment, lease, run, dataset, and result records.
validationPerformed: make test; make research-validate; build/afterstate/self-test (9 checks)
limitations: Self-reported contribution; not yet independently reviewed.
